name: AFB – Auto Form Builder with AI, Contact & Conversational Forms
author: Ali Ghasemirad

sections.description:
Auto Form Builder (AFB) is a free, drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for professional forms — contact forms, multi-step forms, surveys, file-upload forms, and forms with conditional logic — with no code required. Build forms by hand or with AI, turn any form into a friendly conversational chat, and embed your forms on any website, WordPress or not.

Every feature listed here is free and built in. Anything you switch on from the Add-Ons screen — Popups, Form Analytics, spam protection, Slack, user registration — is free too: “Add-Ons” simply means optional modules you enable in one click, never a paid upsell. The only paid extra is the optional AI service, which is off by default (see “AI Features” and “External Services” below).

Watch the full overview video · Support

Why Auto Form Builder?

Unlike form plugins that lock their best features behind expensive subscriptions, Auto Form Builder gives you multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — all free.

Plugin Dashboard

A command center with four KPI cards (total forms, submissions, unread entries, and this week’s activity with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day activity chart, latest entries, a top-forms ranking, module status, and one-click shortcuts. New users get a guided onboarding card.

Drag & Drop Form Builder

Build a form in minutes: drag fields onto the canvas, reorder by drag-and-drop or Move Up/Down, undo/redo, preview on desktop, tablet, and mobile, and copy a shortcode to embed anywhere.

15+ Field Types

Text, Textarea, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Time, Month & Year, Checkbox, Radio, Dropdown, Name, Address, File Upload, Signature, Color Picker, and Page Break (multi-step) — plus four survey fields: Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS, and Opinion Scale.

Conditional Logic

Show or hide any field based on earlier answers, using multiple AND/OR conditions per field. Logic also controls confirmations and emails: change the success message or redirect, reroute the admin notification or change its subject and message, skip it, or send a different confirmation email.

Multi-Step Forms

Split long forms with Page Break fields to boost completion. Add step titles, custom Next/Previous labels, and a progress bar. Answer-based branching skips steps or jumps ahead (forward-only and loop-safe), so every visitor sees only the steps that apply.

Surveys & Visual Results

Build complete surveys with Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS (0–10), and Opinion Scale fields, then read per-question reports: distribution and stacked-bar charts, an automatically calculated NPS score, and a 30-day trend. Survey answers appear formatted in entry details and CSV exports, and conditional logic works with every survey field.

Signature Field

Collect e-signatures inside your form. Visitors sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus; the signature is stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details — ideal for consent forms, agreements, and approvals, on WordPress pages and embedded forms alike.

Full Visual Customization

Make forms match your brand: theme presets (Corporate, Minimal, Modern, and more), reusable saved themes (design once, apply to any form with one click), per-form header image, background, colors, fonts, layout, field and button styling, and visual effects. Every change previews live across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Label & Inside-the-Field Icons

Add an icon next to any field label from a built-in set of 40+ icons or your own PNG/JPG, and place an icon inside Text, Email, Number, Phone, URL, and Drop-down fields. Control each icon’s color, optional background chip, and size per field.

Partial Entries

Don’t lose a lead when someone doesn’t press Submit. In-progress answers are saved and reviewable on the Partial Entries screen. Abandoned entries auto-delete after a retention period you control (1–365 days).

Submission Management

All submissions live in a clean inbox with Unread, Starred, Read, Spam, and Trash tabs. Search by any field value, filter by form or date range, sort, and print — right from the dashboard.

Email Notifications

Per-form admin and user confirmation emails, fully configurable — recipients, subject, and a custom message with placeholders like {submission_data} and {form_name}. Choose styled HTML or plain text, and use conditional rules to send different emails or none.

Embed on Any Website

Every form comes with a ready-made embed code for any site — including non-WordPress platforms and page builders such as WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embed keeps your design, auto-resizes to its content, and stays isolated from the host theme; redirect thank-you pages can even break out of the frame. Also available as a Gutenberg block and a WordPress dashboard widget.

Prefill from URL

Populate fields — including individual Name and Address components — from URL parameters, and forward them securely to embedded forms.

Popup Forms (free)

Show any form in a popup without a second plugin: modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, or a floating launcher button. Choose which pages they appear on, trigger by time delay, scroll depth, exit intent, or element click, cap how often each shows, and decide what happens after a successful submission. Fully keyboard accessible; loads nothing on pages without an eligible popup.

Form Analytics (free)

Track views, submissions, average conversion rate, and per-form breakdowns with a 30-day chart. Sync historical submissions or reset data anytime.

Spam Protection (free)

Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile are both included — use either or both on any form.

User Registration & Login (free)

Turn any form into a registration form: map fields to the account email, username, password, and name (a single Name field is split automatically), choose the new user’s role (never Administrator), and send a custom welcome email with placeholders like {username} and {set_password_url}. Includes an independent login form via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — sign-in, lost password, and reset on your own page. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and never stored with the submission or emailed.

Slack Notifications (free)

Notify your team in Slack the moment a form is submitted. Paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL and choose which forms post to which channels. Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted, no credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.

Webhooks

Send submission data to Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, or any custom endpoint the moment a form is submitted, with an optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret.

Import & Export

Export forms and entries for backup or migration, and import forms onto any WordPress site in seconds — ideal for agencies.

Auto Form CRM Integration

Integrates natively with Auto Form CRM, a dedicated WordPress CRM for managing leads and submissions in one place.

AI Features (optional)

Two optional AI features are available and off by default:

  • AI Assistant — build a form from a plain-English description or an uploaded document, generate conditional logic automatically, get one-click submission summaries and drafted replies, “ask across your submissions,” and use an admin chat assistant that answers questions and even creates forms.
  • AI Conversation — turn any form into a friendly chat that collects answers naturally, with optional appointment booking.

These features run on AIDA, our AI service at autoformcrm.com. A free AIDA account includes free trial credits; after those are used, continued AI usage needs one-time credit packs — while every non-AI feature stays free. Your credit balance is always visible in the plugin. See “External Services” for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.

External Services

Auto Form Builder is privacy-first. By default the plugin does not contact any external service. Every service below is off by default and only runs after you actively opt in.

AIDA — AI Assistant & AI Conversation (optional AI features, off by default)

  • Service & provider: AIDA, the AI service that powers the optional AI features, by Auto Form Builder / Auto Form CRM (https://autoformcrm.com/). Requests are processed by a third-party AI provider, Anthropic.
  • When contacted: only after an administrator enables an AI feature, connects an AIDA account, and then uses it. Otherwise nothing is ever sent, and the core builder never contacts AIDA.
  • Account & cost: the AI features need a free AIDA account (with free trial credits); continued use afterward requires one-time credit packs from autoformcrm.com. The core plugin and all non-AI features stay free and need no account. Your credit balance is shown in the plugin, and purchases always open autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment inside the plugin).
  • Data sent (only for the action you trigger): the form description and any document you upload when building a form; the submission content when you request a summary, a suggested reply, or an “ask across submissions” answer, or when the admin assistant answers about your forms/submissions; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and, only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form, the chat messages visitors type. Your AIDA token is sent server-side only to authenticate, stored encrypted, and never exposed to the browser.
  • Data NOT sent: nothing for any AI feature you do not use, no form/submission content beyond the action you trigger, and never passwords handled by WordPress core.
  • Purpose: to provide AI form building, submission summaries and replies, the admin assistant, and conversational forms.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformcrm.com/terms and https://autoformcrm.com/privacy (Auto Form CRM / AIDA); Anthropic — https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

Anonymous Deactivation Feedback (opt-in, one-time)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder feedback endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-deactivation-feedback.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only when an administrator clicks “Submit & Deactivate” in the optional dialog shown on deactivation. Skipping, closing, or dismissing it sends nothing.
  • Data sent: the reason you selected, an optional explanation (max 1000 characters), your WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, and your site locale. The exact JSON payload is shown in the dialog before anything is sent.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission data (the request User-Agent is neutralized so it carries no site URL).
  • Purpose: to understand why users deactivate the plugin and prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/

Anonymous Usage Data (opt-in, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder telemetry endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-telemetry.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only if you enable “Help improve Auto Form Builder by sending anonymous usage data” (in onboarding or Settings → General) — then a one-time “install” event on opt-in and an “uninstall” event on deletion. Turning it off stops all further requests.
  • Data sent: a locally generated anonymous site ID (not derived from your URL), the plugin / WordPress / PHP / MySQL versions, the plugin version at install, your site locale, whether the site is multisite, days since install, approximate form and submission counts as ranges (never exact), active modules, and whether onboarding was completed. The full list is shown next to the opt-in checkbox.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission content.
  • Purpose: to measure the uninstall rate and which environments and usage levels correlate with leaving, so we can prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/privacy/

Slack Notifications (built-in, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Slack Incoming Webhooks, Slack Technologies, LLC (https://slack.com/). Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted; no other host is ever contacted.
  • When contacted: only after you set a webhook URL you created in your own Slack workspace and enable it for a form — then on each submission of that form and when you click “Send Test”.
  • Data sent: the form title and your site name; the values a visitor submitted only if you also enable “Include answers” for that form. Passwords, CAPTCHA values, file contents, and server file paths are never sent; uploaded files appear by filename only.
  • Purpose: to notify your team in Slack about new form submissions in real time.
  • Terms / privacy: https://slack.com/terms-of-service and https://slack.com/trust/privacy/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Auto Form Builder”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open Auto Form Builder in your admin menu.
  5. Click Create New Form to build your first form.
  6. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free?

Yes. The drag-and-drop builder and every non-AI feature — multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, popups, user registration, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — are 100% free, with nothing essential locked away. The only paid extra is the optional AI service, and only after its free trial credits.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. The drag-and-drop builder needs zero coding. Building, styling, and embedding are all handled through the visual interface.

What field types are available?

Text, Textarea, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Time, Month & Year, Checkbox, Radio, Dropdown, Name, Address, File Upload, Signature, Color Picker, Page Break (multi-step), and four survey fields: Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS, and Opinion Scale.

Can I add conditional logic?

Yes. Every field supports show/hide logic with AND/OR conditions, and logic can also change your confirmation message, redirect, or which email is sent.

Can I create multi-step forms?

Yes. Enable multi-step mode and add Page Break fields where each step starts. You get step titles, custom button labels, progress bar styles, and answer-based branching that skips or jumps steps so visitors only see what applies.

Can I embed my form on another website?

Yes. Every form has a ready-made embed code that works on any site, including non-WordPress platforms and page builders like WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embed keeps your design, resizes automatically, and stays isolated from the host theme. You can also share a direct link to the form as its own page.

Can I show my form in a popup?

Yes, free and built in — no separate popup plugin. Display any form as a modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, or floating launcher, and control which pages it appears on, how it triggers, how often it shows, and what happens after submit.

Can visitors sign my forms with an e-signature?

Yes. Add the Signature field and visitors can sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus. The signature is stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details, on WordPress pages and embedded forms.

Can users register and log in through my forms?

Yes, free and built in. Pick which form creates accounts and map its fields to the account email, username, password, and name. Choose the new role, customize the welcome email, and add an independent login form (with lost password and reset) to any page via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — no default WordPress login screen.

Can I protect my forms from spam?

Yes. Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile are both included free — use either or both on any form.

Do the AI features cost money?

The core builder is free and always will be, with no account required. The optional AI features run on our AIDA service: a free AIDA account comes with free trial credits, and after those are used, continued AI usage needs one-time credit packs bought on autoformcrm.com. So AI is a paid service after the free trial, while everything else stays free. Your credit balance is always visible in the plugin.

What data is sent to external services when I use the AI features?

Only when you actually use an AI feature, and only the content it needs: the form description or uploaded document when building a form; the submission content when you summarize, reply, or “ask across submissions,” or when the admin assistant answers a question; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and — only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form — the chat messages visitors type. Requests are authenticated with your AIDA token (kept encrypted on your server) and processed by our AI provider, Anthropic. Nothing is sent unless you opt in and use the feature. See “External Services” for full details.

Can I use the plugin without the AI features?

Yes. Auto Form Builder is fully functional without any AI. The AI features are off by default — if you never opt in, the plugin never contacts AIDA, and every other feature works exactly as before.

Where can I get support?

Visit autoformbuilder.com/support for documentation and support.
sections.changelog:
1.4.4

  • New: UK Mobile format for the Phone field — validates UK mobile numbers in domestic (07700 900123) and international (+44 7700 900123 or 0044 7700 900123) formats, with optional format-as-you-type. Existing phone fields and other formats are unchanged.
  • New: “Minimum Days From Today” option for the Date field — require the selected date to be at least a set number of days after today (e.g. 3), enforced in the browser and on the server. If a fixed First Allowed Date is also set, the later of the two applies. Existing date fields are unchanged.
  • Improved: The Month & Year (calendar) and Time (clock) field icons now sit on the left, matching the inside-the-field icons for a consistent look across all fields (with right-hand placement kept for RTL sites).
  • New: Inside-the-field icon support for the Drop-down field — show a built-in or uploaded icon at the start of the dropdown, matching the other fields. Dropdowns without an icon are unchanged.
  • New: Auto-fill field values with conditional logic — automatically set a Text, Textarea, Number, Email, Phone, or URL field to a fixed value or copy another field’s value when your conditions are met. If the visitor edits the field their input is kept, and an auto-filled value is cleared again if the conditions stop matching. Works independently of the existing Show/Hide rules, so a field can use either or both.

1.4.3

  • New: Month & Year field — collect month/year with an easy custom picker (year arrows and a single month grid), or year only with a year dropdown. Works with conditional logic, entry details, admin/user email notifications, URL prefill, AI form builder defaults, and AI Conversation forms. Existing Date fields are unchanged.
  • New: “Block Future Dates” option for the Month & Year field, so answers cannot be later than the current month or year — ideal for questions like “When was your business established?”. Combine it with the Earliest Month/Year setting to bound both ends.
  • New: Save your Customize design as a reusable theme, then apply it to your other forms with one click. Saved themes live in the Customize → Theme panel; existing forms and themes are unchanged.
  • New: Label icons — add an icon next to any field label from a built-in library of 40+ icons, or upload your own PNG/JPG. Control the icon color, optional background chip, and size per field. Fields without an icon are completely unchanged.
  • New: Inside-the-field icons — show an icon at the start of Text, Email, Number, Phone and URL fields, separated from the value by a divider. Choose a built-in icon or a PNG/JPG and set its color, background and size. Fields without an icon are completely unchanged.
  • New: Popups — show any form in a popup without installing a second plugin. Create unlimited popups (modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, floating launcher), pick the pages they appear on, trigger them by time, scroll, exit intent, clicks and more, cap how often they show, and choose what happens after a successful submission. Fully keyboard accessible, loads nothing on pages without an eligible popup.
  • Improved: The Popups editor now warns you about unsaved changes before you close it or leave the page, so popup edits are no longer lost by accident.

1.4.2

  • Fixed: Name field with separate parts now labels each part correctly (e.g. “First Name” and “Last Name”) in the submission details, email notifications, and stored entries, instead of showing “Name” twice.
  • Fixed: When only First Name and/or Last Name are marked required, the required asterisk now appears next to those parts.
  • Fixed: The required asterisk no longer appears on every individual radio button or checkbox option — it now shows only on the field’s own label.

1.4.1

  • New: URL prefill for individual Name and Address components — First, Middle, Last and Suffix, plus Company/Organization, Address Line 1 and 2, City, State/Province/Region and ZIP/Postal Code can each read their own URL parameter, so composite fields can be pre-populated from a link without workarounds.
  • New: AI Assistant and AI Conversation are now active by default on fresh installs, and are enabled once on upgrade for existing sites. If you deactivate either, it stays off.
  • New: “Build with AI” now always appears in the “Create a new form” dialog. When the AI Assistant is inactive it guides you to activate it, and when it is active but not yet connected it guides you to connect AIDA.
  • New: Dismissible dashboard and Add-Ons prompts that walk you through activating the free AI features and then connecting AIDA, so the AI features are easy to discover.
  • New: Export / Import button on the Submissions and Partial Entries screens that links straight to the CSV export and import tools.
  • Fixed: URL-prefilled dropdowns (including searchable dropdowns) now fire the same change event as a manual selection, so conditional logic evaluates on page load and dependent fields show or hide correctly.

1.4.0

Released: 2026-08-06.

  • New: AI Assistant (optional, off by default) — connect a free AIDA account to bring AI to your forms:
    • Build a form with AI from a plain-English description.
    • Document-to-form — upload a document and turn it into a ready-to-edit form.
    • Automatic conditional logic generation as part of AI form building.
    • One-click submission summaries and AI-drafted replies.
    • “Ask across your submissions” — answer questions spanning all entries of a form.
    • Admin AI chat assistant — a built-in assistant that answers questions about your forms and submissions and can create new forms for you.
  • New: AI Conversation (now built-in, optional, off by default) — turn any form into a friendly conversational form: an AI chat that collects answers naturally, with optional appointment booking via Auto Form CRM.
  • New: AIDA credits — a single shared credit balance that powers both AI features, always visible in the plugin. New accounts start with free trial credits; afterward, top up with one-time credit packs purchased on autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment ever happens inside the plugin). See the AIDA entry in the “External Services” section of this readme for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.
  • Note: The core drag-and-drop form builder and all non-AI features remain completely free and never require an account. The AI features are opt-in and connect to AIDA only after you enable one.

1.3.1

  • New: Per-component Required checkboxes on the Address field for Address Line 2, State/Province/Region, ZIP/Postal Code, Country, and Company/Organization — each appears under its component in Advanced Settings and can be toggled independently.
  • Improved: Marking the Address field itself Required now automatically requires the two always-rendered core components (Address Line 1 and City), so a required address can no longer be submitted empty.
  • Improved: Address country component — when the country is shown and Required, no default country is silently preselected (visitors must choose explicitly), and Hide Country never bypasses a shown, required country.
  • Improved: Address renderer skips the Required flag for any component that is hidden, so a “required” toggle on a disabled component never blocks submission.
  • Fixed: Conditional logic now works in every copy of a form on the page, including page-builder popups (Brizy, Elementor, WP Bakery, etc.) that clone or lazy-inject form markup — the manager tracks every DOM instance and listens at the document capture phase so overlays that stop event propagation cannot silence it.
  • Fixed: Multi-step forms now correctly hide inactive steps even when a site serves a stale cached stylesheet — steps are hidden inline in addition to via CSS.
  • Fixed: Required Name field with “Separate fields (First name, Last name)” enabled now validates the subfield values correctly and no longer reports the field as missing when it was filled in.
  • Fixed: Required Address field now validates the submitted address components correctly and no longer reports the field as missing when it was filled in.
  • Fixed: Required radio groups are enforced even when a page builder strips the native required attribute from the inputs (via a container-level flag), so radio validation keeps working inside popups.
  • Fixed: Address subfield validation preserves the camelCase keys addressLine1 / addressLine2 so per-component labels and Required rules resolve correctly on submit.
  • Improved: conditional-logic.js and multistep.js are now versioned by file modification time, so browser and CDN caches automatically pick up future frontend script fixes without requiring a full plugin version bump.

1.3

  • New: Redesigned plugin dashboard — personalized hero header, four KPI cards (forms, submissions, unread, and this week with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day submission activity chart, recent entries, top-performing-forms ranking, built-in module status, quick actions, and a guided onboarding card when no forms exist yet.
  • New: Multi-step forms — enable in Form Settings and split any form with Page Break fields, with step titles, custom Next/Previous button labels, and multiple progress bar styles.
  • New: Step branching — skip a step or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only, loop-safe), so every visitor only sees the steps that apply to them.
  • New: Partial entry capture — optionally save in-progress answers, review them under Partial Entries, and auto-delete abandoned entries after a configurable retention period (1–365 days).
  • New: Slack Notifications — post a message to a Slack channel the moment a form is submitted, using Slack Incoming Webhooks. Enable notifications per form, send different forms to different channels, choose per form whether the submitted answers are included, and verify your setup with a one-click test message. Only hooks.slack.com webhook URLs are accepted, no Slack credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.
  • Improved: Survey field answers in notification emails — ratings and scales show as score/max with end labels, and matrix answers list each question clearly (no NPS segment labels in confirmation emails).
  • Fixed: Duplicating a form now regenerates field IDs and remaps conditional logic, branching, settings, and email merge tags, so copies never collide with the original on the same page.
  • Fixed: Checkbox/radio, email, and searchable dropdown handlers work correctly when the same form is rendered more than once (e.g. page + popup).
  • Fixed: Conditionally hidden fields stay hidden even when a site serves a stale cached stylesheet.
  • Fixed: Required checkbox groups are validated correctly on the frontend.

1.2.9

  • New: Survey field types — a new “Survey” category in the form builder with four field types, all free: Tabular Survey (a rows × columns Likert grid with an optional multiple-answers-per-row mode that collapses neatly on mobile), Star Rating (3–10 stars, keyboard accessible), NPS (the standard 0–10 Net Promoter Score scale with color-coded answers), and Opinion Scale (numbered 0/1–10 buttons with custom labels for each end).
  • New: Survey Results page — a new admin screen with visual, per-question results: answer distribution charts for ratings and scales, stacked bar charts for tabular surveys, option counts for radio/dropdown/checkbox questions, an automatic NPS score with the Promoter/Passive/Detractor breakdown, and a 30-day response trend.
  • New: Survey answers are shown in a readable format in the entry details (stars, NPS segment badges, per-question matrix answers) and CSV exports now write structured answers as readable text instead of raw code.
  • New: Conditional logic works with all survey fields — for example, show a “What can we improve?” question only when the NPS score is 6 or less. Rules on a tabular survey match any row’s answer, and the rule editor now shows guidance (valid ranges, tips) when a survey field is selected.
  • Improved: Survey fields follow the form’s Customize colors — scale buttons, matrix answers, and focus outlines use the form’s primary color instead of a fixed blue.
  • Fixed: Star rating and tabular survey accessibility labels could appear as visible text on themes without screen-reader styles; the plugin now ships its own.
  • Fixed: Form Analytics charts load again — the Chart.js library it relies on is now shipped with the plugin.

1.2.8

  • New: Gutenberg block — insert any form directly from the block editor. Pick the form from a dropdown and see a live, styled preview right in the editor; the block always renders the latest version of the form, so no shortcodes are needed.
  • New: WordPress dashboard widget — see your forms, total and unread submissions, and this week’s activity at a glance on the main WordPress dashboard, with a 7-day submissions chart, the latest entries (unread highlighted), and one-click shortcuts to create a form or open submissions.
  • New: Prefill from URL parameters — enable “Prefill from URL Parameter” on text, email, phone, number, dropdown, and radio fields to fill them automatically from links like ?business-name=Acme. Also works for forms embedded on other websites: the host page’s URL parameters are forwarded to the embedded form securely.
  • New: Color Picker field — let visitors pick a color with the native color selector. The chosen color is validated, stored with the submission, and shown as a color swatch next to its hex code in the entry details.

1.2.7

  • New: User Registration & Login — create WordPress accounts automatically from form submissions. Map form fields to the account email, username, password, and first/last name (a single Full Name field is split automatically), choose the role new users receive (Administrator is never selectable), and respect or override the site’s “Anyone can register” setting. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and never stored with the submission or included in any email.
  • New: Independent login form — the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode now handles signing in, lost password, and password reset entirely on your own page; visitors never see the default WordPress login screen. Error and confirmation messages appear inline and never reveal whether an account exists.
  • New: Login form appearance settings — customize the username/password labels, button text, five colors (button, button text, text, links, background), and corner radius from the settings page.
  • New: Custom welcome email — replace the standard WordPress new-user email with your own subject and message, using placeholders such as {username}, {email}, {first_name}, {site_name}, {login_url}, and {set_password_url}.
  • Improved: Webhooks, analytics, and other submission actions now also run for forms whose confirmation is a redirect (previously they were skipped for redirect-only forms).
  • Developer: New auto_form_builder_processed_submission_data filter lets integrations adjust submission data before it is stored, emailed, or passed to webhooks.

1.2.6

  • New: Conditional confirmations — show a different success message or redirect to a different thank-you page based on the visitor’s answers, with multiple rules combined using AND/OR logic (first matching rule wins).
  • New: Conditional email rules — skip the admin notification or send it to a different address with a different subject and message based on the visitor’s answers; the user confirmation email can be skipped or customized the same way.
  • New: Plain text email format — choose between the styled HTML layout and a simple plain-text format for admin notifications and user confirmation emails, per form.
  • New: Custom Message field for admin notification emails — write your own notification body with the same placeholders as the confirmation email, such as {submission_data} and {form_name}.
  • New: Help text on the Forms screen explaining the difference between the shortcode Copy button (this website) and the Copy embed code button (any other website).

1.2.5

  • New: Signature field — let visitors draw an e-signature (mouse, touch or stylus) that is saved with the submission and shown in the entry details. Works on regular pages and embedded forms.

short_description: Drag & drop AI form builder for WordPress. Build forms with AI, add conversational forms & an admin AI assistant, embed anywhere. Free core builder.
description:
Auto Form Builder (AFB) is a free, drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for professional forms — contact forms, multi-step forms, surveys, file-upload forms, and forms with conditional logic — with no code required. Build forms by hand or with AI, turn any form into a friendly conversational chat, and embed your forms on any website, WordPress or not.

Every feature listed here is free and built in. Anything you switch on from the Add-Ons screen — Popups, Form Analytics, spam protection, Slack, user registration — is free too: “Add-Ons” simply means optional modules you enable in one click, never a paid upsell. The only paid extra is the optional AI service, which is off by default (see “AI Features” and “External Services” below).

Watch the full overview video · Support

Why Auto Form Builder?

Unlike form plugins that lock their best features behind expensive subscriptions, Auto Form Builder gives you multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — all free.

Plugin Dashboard

A command center with four KPI cards (total forms, submissions, unread entries, and this week’s activity with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day activity chart, latest entries, a top-forms ranking, module status, and one-click shortcuts. New users get a guided onboarding card.

Drag & Drop Form Builder

Build a form in minutes: drag fields onto the canvas, reorder by drag-and-drop or Move Up/Down, undo/redo, preview on desktop, tablet, and mobile, and copy a shortcode to embed anywhere.

15+ Field Types

Text, Textarea, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Time, Month & Year, Checkbox, Radio, Dropdown, Name, Address, File Upload, Signature, Color Picker, and Page Break (multi-step) — plus four survey fields: Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS, and Opinion Scale.

Conditional Logic

Show or hide any field based on earlier answers, using multiple AND/OR conditions per field. Logic also controls confirmations and emails: change the success message or redirect, reroute the admin notification or change its subject and message, skip it, or send a different confirmation email.

Multi-Step Forms

Split long forms with Page Break fields to boost completion. Add step titles, custom Next/Previous labels, and a progress bar. Answer-based branching skips steps or jumps ahead (forward-only and loop-safe), so every visitor sees only the steps that apply.

Surveys & Visual Results

Build complete surveys with Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS (0–10), and Opinion Scale fields, then read per-question reports: distribution and stacked-bar charts, an automatically calculated NPS score, and a 30-day trend. Survey answers appear formatted in entry details and CSV exports, and conditional logic works with every survey field.

Signature Field

Collect e-signatures inside your form. Visitors sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus; the signature is stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details — ideal for consent forms, agreements, and approvals, on WordPress pages and embedded forms alike.

Full Visual Customization

Make forms match your brand: theme presets (Corporate, Minimal, Modern, and more), reusable saved themes (design once, apply to any form with one click), per-form header image, background, colors, fonts, layout, field and button styling, and visual effects. Every change previews live across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Label & Inside-the-Field Icons

Add an icon next to any field label from a built-in set of 40+ icons or your own PNG/JPG, and place an icon inside Text, Email, Number, Phone, URL, and Drop-down fields. Control each icon’s color, optional background chip, and size per field.

Partial Entries

Don’t lose a lead when someone doesn’t press Submit. In-progress answers are saved and reviewable on the Partial Entries screen. Abandoned entries auto-delete after a retention period you control (1–365 days).

Submission Management

All submissions live in a clean inbox with Unread, Starred, Read, Spam, and Trash tabs. Search by any field value, filter by form or date range, sort, and print — right from the dashboard.

Email Notifications

Per-form admin and user confirmation emails, fully configurable — recipients, subject, and a custom message with placeholders like {submission_data} and {form_name}. Choose styled HTML or plain text, and use conditional rules to send different emails or none.

Embed on Any Website

Every form comes with a ready-made embed code for any site — including non-WordPress platforms and page builders such as WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embed keeps your design, auto-resizes to its content, and stays isolated from the host theme; redirect thank-you pages can even break out of the frame. Also available as a Gutenberg block and a WordPress dashboard widget.

Prefill from URL

Populate fields — including individual Name and Address components — from URL parameters, and forward them securely to embedded forms.

Popup Forms (free)

Show any form in a popup without a second plugin: modal, slide-in, sticky bar, full-screen, welcome mat, or a floating launcher button. Choose which pages they appear on, trigger by time delay, scroll depth, exit intent, or element click, cap how often each shows, and decide what happens after a successful submission. Fully keyboard accessible; loads nothing on pages without an eligible popup.

Form Analytics (free)

Track views, submissions, average conversion rate, and per-form breakdowns with a 30-day chart. Sync historical submissions or reset data anytime.

Spam Protection (free)

Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile are both included — use either or both on any form.

User Registration & Login (free)

Turn any form into a registration form: map fields to the account email, username, password, and name (a single Name field is split automatically), choose the new user’s role (never Administrator), and send a custom welcome email with placeholders like {username} and {set_password_url}. Includes an independent login form via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — sign-in, lost password, and reset on your own page. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and never stored with the submission or emailed.

Slack Notifications (free)

Notify your team in Slack the moment a form is submitted. Paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL and choose which forms post to which channels. Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted, no credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.

Webhooks

Send submission data to Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, or any custom endpoint the moment a form is submitted, with an optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret.

Import & Export

Export forms and entries for backup or migration, and import forms onto any WordPress site in seconds — ideal for agencies.

Auto Form CRM Integration

Integrates natively with Auto Form CRM, a dedicated WordPress CRM for managing leads and submissions in one place.

AI Features (optional)

Two optional AI features are available and off by default:

  • AI Assistant — build a form from a plain-English description or an uploaded document, generate conditional logic automatically, get one-click submission summaries and drafted replies, “ask across your submissions,” and use an admin chat assistant that answers questions and even creates forms.
  • AI Conversation — turn any form into a friendly chat that collects answers naturally, with optional appointment booking.

These features run on AIDA, our AI service at autoformcrm.com. A free AIDA account includes free trial credits; after those are used, continued AI usage needs one-time credit packs — while every non-AI feature stays free. Your credit balance is always visible in the plugin. See “External Services” for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.

External Services

Auto Form Builder is privacy-first. By default the plugin does not contact any external service. Every service below is off by default and only runs after you actively opt in.

AIDA — AI Assistant & AI Conversation (optional AI features, off by default)

  • Service & provider: AIDA, the AI service that powers the optional AI features, by Auto Form Builder / Auto Form CRM (https://autoformcrm.com/). Requests are processed by a third-party AI provider, Anthropic.
  • When contacted: only after an administrator enables an AI feature, connects an AIDA account, and then uses it. Otherwise nothing is ever sent, and the core builder never contacts AIDA.
  • Account & cost: the AI features need a free AIDA account (with free trial credits); continued use afterward requires one-time credit packs from autoformcrm.com. The core plugin and all non-AI features stay free and need no account. Your credit balance is shown in the plugin, and purchases always open autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment inside the plugin).
  • Data sent (only for the action you trigger): the form description and any document you upload when building a form; the submission content when you request a summary, a suggested reply, or an “ask across submissions” answer, or when the admin assistant answers about your forms/submissions; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and, only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form, the chat messages visitors type. Your AIDA token is sent server-side only to authenticate, stored encrypted, and never exposed to the browser.
  • Data NOT sent: nothing for any AI feature you do not use, no form/submission content beyond the action you trigger, and never passwords handled by WordPress core.
  • Purpose: to provide AI form building, submission summaries and replies, the admin assistant, and conversational forms.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformcrm.com/terms and https://autoformcrm.com/privacy (Auto Form CRM / AIDA); Anthropic — https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

Anonymous Deactivation Feedback (opt-in, one-time)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder feedback endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-deactivation-feedback.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only when an administrator clicks “Submit & Deactivate” in the optional dialog shown on deactivation. Skipping, closing, or dismissing it sends nothing.
  • Data sent: the reason you selected, an optional explanation (max 1000 characters), your WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, and your site locale. The exact JSON payload is shown in the dialog before anything is sent.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission data (the request User-Agent is neutralized so it carries no site URL).
  • Purpose: to understand why users deactivate the plugin and prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/

Anonymous Usage Data (opt-in, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Auto Form Builder telemetry endpoint, https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-telemetry.php (https://autoformbuilder.com/).
  • When contacted: only if you enable “Help improve Auto Form Builder by sending anonymous usage data” (in onboarding or Settings → General) — then a one-time “install” event on opt-in and an “uninstall” event on deletion. Turning it off stops all further requests.
  • Data sent: a locally generated anonymous site ID (not derived from your URL), the plugin / WordPress / PHP / MySQL versions, the plugin version at install, your site locale, whether the site is multisite, days since install, approximate form and submission counts as ranges (never exact), active modules, and whether onboarding was completed. The full list is shown next to the opt-in checkbox.
  • Data NOT sent: site URL, administrator name or email, user ID, IP address, or any form/submission content.
  • Purpose: to measure the uninstall rate and which environments and usage levels correlate with leaving, so we can prioritise improvements.
  • Terms / privacy: https://autoformbuilder.com/privacy/

Slack Notifications (built-in, off by default)

  • Service & provider: Slack Incoming Webhooks, Slack Technologies, LLC (https://slack.com/). Only hooks.slack.com URLs are accepted; no other host is ever contacted.
  • When contacted: only after you set a webhook URL you created in your own Slack workspace and enable it for a form — then on each submission of that form and when you click “Send Test”.
  • Data sent: the form title and your site name; the values a visitor submitted only if you also enable “Include answers” for that form. Passwords, CAPTCHA values, file contents, and server file paths are never sent; uploaded files appear by filename only.
  • Purpose: to notify your team in Slack about new form submissions in real time.
  • Terms / privacy: https://slack.com/terms-of-service and https://slack.com/trust/privacy/privacy-policy

Forms list — view, edit, duplicate, and manage all forms with shortcodes
Create New Form — choose from pre-built templates or start with a blank canvas
Form Builder — drag-and-drop editor with conditional logic per field
Customize Tab — theme presets, header image, colors, fonts, and live mobile preview
Form Settings — submission behavior, success message, and email notifications
Submission Management — inbox-style with search, filter, and spam protection
Plugin Settings — general settings, import/export, webhooks, and system status
Add-Ons — free built-in modules: Form Analytics, reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare Turnstile
Help & Support — built-in quick start guide and full field reference
Form Analytics — views, submissions, conversion rates, and per-form performance
Analytics Chart — 30-day activity chart with daily breakdown and data management
